importantFindings.title: 03 §6 states the documentation-only CI skip without the condition that fixes round 1's blocker
importantFindings.evidence: 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md:231-232: 'A push that changes only documentation, evidence, milestone metadata or agent definitions runs `verify` instead (scripts/ci-scope.mjs)', with no condition. The ladder line at :209, 'release gates and CI: verify:all', has no exception either. The guard that closes SCO-H1-2/CQ-1 (the skip applies only when CI's 'verify' job succeeded on the previous tip) exists only in scripts/ci-scope.mjs:5-9 and :27-40 and in a ci.yml comment (:47-50). I checked the fix itself and it holds: needsBrowser(files, false) is true; a failed, cancelled or running previous run, before=000..., or an unknown before all run verify:all; and the deploy publishes only green push runs. But 03 ranks above code (AGENTS.md §2). Anyone who 'aligns' ci-scope with 03 brings the blocker back.
importantFindings.specRef: Persona lens 4 (behaviour changed without the spec text); docs/DOCS_SYSTEM.md rule 1; AGENTS.md §2

importantFindings.title: The closure relies on a local verify:all, which 03 §6.1 calls advisory, and the frozen-evidence rule leaves no sanctioned way to record a fix CI forces later
importantFindings.evidence: 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md:241-246: 'CI is the authority for the browser suite. A local run is advisory ... must not present it as the gate.' The success predicate says 'verify:all passes'. The pending list in the brief (two-worker trial, test-timing.json, final recorded verify:all, retro-adoption, sweep) contains no CI run of the H1 source. The closing order is complete, commit, then push (SKILL.md §6), so CI first sees H1 after it is COMPLETE. H1 changes Playwright project membership and may set workers to 2, neither measured on the Linux runner. UG2 is the precedent: 04bdc51 was a CI-only Linux-font fix after 'Complete UG2', and 0bd07d8 re-recorded the evidence. Under H1's own rules that re-record is now refused. scripts/record-verification.mjs:103-104 always writes .evidence/<ID>/verification.json. The pre-commit hook now runs `check-docs --cached --frozen-only`, and frozenProblems refuses any deletion in the evidence of a milestone that is COMPLETE at HEAD (scripts/check-docs.mjs:78-94).
importantFindings.reproduction: Code path, not executed (read-only): after the 'Complete H1' commit, a CI failure is fixed and `npm run evidence -- H1` rewrites .evidence/H1/verification.json, changing existing lines. `git commit` runs scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit, check-docs reports '.evidence/H1/verification.json: frozen file changed', and the commit is refused.
importantFindings.specRef: 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md §6.1; persona lens 9 (a local run presented as the CI gate); docs/DOCS_SYSTEM.md rule 6. Fix: hold completion until CI passes on the pushed H1 commit, or record the CI run (run id, commit, conclusion) as an added evidence file; give the recorder an output name for runs after completion.

qolFindings.title: The frozen-file exception approves a path forever, not one dated edit
qolFindings.evidence: approvedFrozenEdits (scripts/check-docs.mjs:98-107) returns every backticked string on a '- ' line of the exception section. frozenProblems (:89) then skips that path for every later edit, and the date is never compared. DOCS_SYSTEM.md:50-53 says 'the edit is listed, with its date'. In the pre-commit hook's --cached mode, the list comes from the working tree's archive/README.md, not the staged one. No path is listed today.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code path: list `CHANGELOG.md` once, and every later deletion in CHANGELOG.md prints 'Frozen edit approved' and passes.

qolFindings.title: In CI the frozen-file check silently checks nothing when the previous tip is unknown
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/check-docs.mjs:222-234 falls back to HEAD when CVC_DOCS_BASE is 000... (a new branch) or the commit is not in the clone, so the diff is empty. DOCS_SYSTEM.md:72-74 says without condition 'so a committed edit is caught too'. A later ordinary push to main does catch it, because it diffs from the old main tip.
